component.name: Linxira Crash Watch
component.summary: Capture crashes and hand one to the agent on request

description.p: Watches systemd-coredump, records text-only crash events, and shows an actionable notification. Capture, notification, and timeout triage cost no tokens; the agent is only launched when the user explicitly asks.
Raw core dumps stay in systemd-coredump's store and never enter the debug workspace or leave the machine.
